TakeDamageSfxType.rationale: Presentation only, per SHARED-FINDINGS section 4 (monster stream) and monster_state_machine guards N2/N5. DamageSfxType.Armor.

AfterAddedToRoom.rationale: Presentation only, per SHARED-FINDINGS section 4 (monster stream) and monster_state_machine guards N2/N5. The whole override body is `if (TestMode.IsOff) { FabricatorNormal.SetBotFallPosition(NCombatRoom.Instance.GetCreatureNode(Creature)); }` -- SetBotFallPosition (FabricatorNormal.cs:60-68) writes a Node2D's Position so the bot drops in from the right height. Read to the END before deciding, per the KinPriest N6 precedent: there is no mechanical statement in it at all. The sim has no override and needs none.

GenerateMoveStateMachine.rationale: Noisebot.cs:42-49 is one self-looping MoveState('NOISE_MOVE', NoiseMove, new StatusIntent(2)); fabricator.py:58-61 is identical with Intent(MoveType.STATUS_CARD). No branch state on either side.

guards.what: NoiseMove pile targets and ORDER (Noisebot.cs:51-71 vs fabricator.py:63-67)
guards.rationale: C# adds Dazed #1 to PileType.Discard (statusCards[0], Noisebot.cs:61) and Dazed #2 to PileType.Draw at CardPilePosition.Random (:64), in that order. The sim calls add_to_discard then add_to_draw (fabricator.py:66-67), same order, so the one random insertion happens at the same point in the sequence. The random slot is the part that could silently drift and does not: CardPileCmd.add_to_draw draws it from the SHUFFLE stream in parity mode (`crng.shuffle.randrange(count + 1)`, cmds.py:490-496) and converts the game index to the sim's reversed pile orientation, exactly mirroring CardPileCmd.cs:514. `target.Player ?? target.PetOwner` (:57) resolves to the one player in Ironclad-only scope, which is ctx.player.

guards.what: StatusIntent(2)'s CardCount is dropped by the sim's Intent (Noisebot.cs:45 vs fabricator.py:59)
guards.rationale: Presentation only, per SHARED-FINDINGS section 4 (monster stream) and monster_state_machine guards N2/N5. The sim's Intent dataclass (monsters/base.py:36-59) carries move_type / damage / hits / buffs / also and has no status-card count. Executed: StatusIntent.CardCount (StatusIntent.cs:20) is read only by GetIntentLabel and GetIntentDescription in the same file, both of which do nothing but `LocString.Add("CardCount", CardCount)` for the intent tooltip; `grep -rn CardCount src/` returns no other consumer of this property. On the sim side no consumer of Intent reads a status count either -- the only readers are env.py:167 and full_env.py:571, both `intent.has(MoveType.STATUS_CARD)` booleans. The number of cards actually added is correct on both sides (2). monster_state_machine boundary item 2 leaves the intent vocabulary unaudited; this entry settles the one clause this unit exposes.

Noisebot is the only bot with no attack and no constructor power; its HP band 18/23 matches Stabbot and Zapbot but not Guardbot, and its AfterAddedToRoom is the synchronous visual-only form (contrast Zapbot's async one). Read independently, not inherited.
